recordSchema.id: Unique stable college identifier, such as college-example-001.
recordSchema.name: Official institution name.
recordSchema.institutionType: Government, private, deemed, public, autonomous or other applicable classification.
recordSchema.stateCode: State or region identifier, where applicable.

validationRules: Every college record must have a unique id and slug.
College names must match the institution’s official name or clearly identify an approved display name.
All courseIds must reference existing records in courses.json.
Entrance exam IDs must reference existing examination records when such a dataset is available.
Admission process IDs must reference existing admission-process records when used.
Official websites and application links must be checked before publication.
Recognition claims must be supported by an authoritative source.
Fees must identify the currency, relevant academic year and fee period when known.
Unknown values must remain null or use the explicitly defined unknown status.
Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD or null.
Application end dates must not precede application start dates when both are provided.
Verification dates must reflect actual checks and must never be fabricated.
A featured or active record must not be represented as verified solely because it is enabled for display.
Outdated admission details must be reviewed before being displayed as current.
Never invent college names, affiliations, recognition, fees, rankings or admission deadlines.
note: Populate college records using current institutional, regulator and government sources. Verify course availability and admission details for each relevant academic year before publishing them as confirmed information.
